## Quick comparison

| Model | Battery | Output | Solar input |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Anker F3800 Plus | 3.84 kWh | 6,000 W | 3,200 W |
| EcoFlow DELTA Pro 3 | 4.096 kWh | 4,000 W | 2,600 W |
| Jackery 5000 Plus | 5.04 kWh | 7,200 W | 4,000 W |

Sources: [Eco Solar Kits](https://ecosolarkits.com/blogs/guides/best-solar-generators-for-home-backup), [PowerOutage.us](https://poweroutage.us/generators/best-solar-portable-generators), [Unplugged Watts](https://www.unpluggedwatts.com/3000-watt-solar-generator-comparison/).

## Which solar panels should you get?

For home backup, I would prioritize **a large solar array rather than just one or two portable panels.**

- **Anker F3800 Plus:** Up to 3,200 W of solar input. The Anker SOLIX PS400 panels are one option mentioned in your sources.
- **EcoFlow DELTA Pro 3:** Up to 2,600 W of solar input. Consider EcoFlow's compatible solar panels.
- **Jackery 5000 Plus:** Up to 4,000 W of solar input for faster replenishment.

The goal is to recharge during daylight while continuing to use electricity, particularly during outages that last several days.

## Important: What do you want to power?

| Backup requirement | My recommendation |
|---|---|
| Refrigerator, lights, Wi-Fi, laptops | Smaller system can work |
| Refrigerator, microwave, window AC | Larger 3–4 kWh system |
| Well pump or 240V appliances | Anker F3800 Plus or EcoFlow DELTA Pro 3 |
| Multiple home circuits | Expandable system + transfer switch |
| Several days of backup | Larger battery bank + substantial solar panels |

**Important:** Connecting a generator to home circuits requires appropriate equipment, such as a transfer switch or approved home panel connection, installed by a licensed electrician. Never backfeed through an ordinary outlet. See [Eco Solar Kits' safety guidance](https://ecosolarkits.com/blogs/guides/best-solar-generators-for-home-backup).

## My recommendation

I would shortlist the **Anker SOLIX F3800 Plus + solar panels** first. It offers a particularly compelling combination of 240V support, high output, expandable storage, and substantial solar charging capacity.

- [Buy Anker SOLIX F3800 Plus](https://ecosolarkits.com/blogs/guides/best-solar-generators-for-home-backup)
- [Buy EcoFlow DELTA Pro 3](https://us.ecoflow.com/products/delta-pro-portable-power-station?hl=en-US)
- [Explore EcoFlow DELTA Pro Ultra](https://us.ecoflow.com/products/delta-pro-ultra?variant=40758830071881)

One question that would really help narrow this down: **Are you trying to back up just essential appliances (refrigerator, lights, Wi-Fi), or your entire home, including central AC or a well pump?** That makes a big difference in how much battery capacity and solar panel wattage you should buy.
